Before/after evidence:
- **Route table:** the command you gave fails the same way before and after (`AttributeError: 'Mount' object has no attribute 'methods'`, from the static mount). I used `getattr(r, 'methods', None)` instead and ran it on a copy of the base commit and on HEAD. The two sorted lists are equal: 35 entries, 30 API routes plus /openapi.json, /docs, /docs/oauth2-redirect, /redoc and the mount, with nothing added. The mount is still last, and /api/mock/new still comes before /api/mock/{num}.
- **OpenAPI:** `app.openapi()` dumped as sorted JSON is identical before and after, so every path, method, parameter (X-Learner, X-Tz with ge=-840, le=720) and model is unchanged.
- **test_flow:** exit 0 and "all good" before and after. The ok-lines are the same except one diagnostic grid-in label, which changes between runs because the form is drawn at random. After the change there are 46 ok-lines against 45 before; the extra one is the new server/checks/f0.py ("ok  the manifest is JSON, its icons are served, and all 14 pages carry the head").
- **Pages:** I ran my own server on port 8010 with `SATF_DB=/tmp/f0.db` and walked all 14 pages with Playwright at 1280 and 390. Every page returned 200 with no console errors, page errors or failed requests. head.js, kit.js and charts.js load on the 13 pages that use ui.js, and head.js alone on /test/, which has no ui.js. With satf.look set, head.js applied theme dark, text large and motion reduce, and left no global variables behind. The server log shows no non-200 responses. I stopped the server afterwards; ports 8000 and server/satfreshman.db were not touched.
- **Spec acceptance:** `grep -L head.js web/**/*.html` is empty, and `curl localhost:8010/manifest.webmanifest` returns JSON served as application/manifest+json.

Where I departed from the spec or the task text:
- **head.js:** the §2.13 snippet is wrapped in `(function(){...})()`. Unwrapped, its `var l` and `var d` become page globals and would break any page script that declares `let d` or `const l`.
- **Extra head line:** the sweep also adds `<link rel="apple-touch-icon">`, since the 180px icon is unused without it.
- **.gitignore:** besides `server/reports/`, `server/*.db.*` and `server/*.db-journal`, it now has `!web/assets/*.png`. The existing `*.png` rule would otherwise have kept the icons out of git.
- **daily.py:** it re-exports the moved names (challenge, board, MIX, LADDER, CHALLENGE_SIZE and the rest) so old imports and test_flow still work. The compete router calls server/challenge.py directly.
- **GZip:** §2.12 says app.py "keeps GZip", but the current app has no GZip middleware. I did not add it, because that would change responses.
- **X-Tz:** `deps.tz_of` is a FastAPI dependency (`Depends(tz_of)`) holding the same header check. The OpenAPI comparison confirms the endpoints did not change.
- **Registries:** app.py lists all 18 planned routers in `ROUTERS` and includes each one whose module exists. `STARTUP` adds account, achievements, challenge, compete, daily, papers, plan, prefs, progress and words, and startup calls `init()` on any that define it. `deps.part()` returns None only when the module itself is missing; a module that exists but fails to import raises.
- **README:** the unchanged paragraphs moved under the task that rebuilds each one, and the paragraph on the day was split between S3 (daily.py) and S8 (challenge.py). Subsections with nothing yet say "Not built yet."
- **Icons:** rendered from mark.svg with headless Chromium, at 80% size on white.

The new files are the nine routers, deps.py and challenge.py under server/, plus server/checks/ (`__init__.py` and f0.py). Under web/ they are manifest.webmanifest and, in assets/, head.js, kit.js, charts.js, icon-192.png, icon-512.png and apple-touch-icon.png.
